figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. (A) HPLC profiles of culture medium and mycelium extracts. i shows profiles from the parental control strain (LO11945) that does not
contain the ahm BGC. ii shows profiles from a strain (LO12048) that carries the ahm BGC refactored in A. nidulans as well as a phenylpyruvate
reductase gene from A. homomorphus. iii shows profiles from a strain (LO12291) in which the phenylpyruvate reductase gene has been deleted.
Eight compounds are detected in the ahm BGC expressing strains, and the profiles are essentially the same regardless of whether the phenypyruvate
reductase gene is present. (B) Structures of compounds 1−8.
